definitions.name: Ultrasonic-I2C

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: Write command byte 0x01 to 0x57, wait 120 ms in the official driver, then read three bytes as a big-endian 24-bit distance value. Driver divides the raw value by 1000 for millimeters and optionally by a further 10 for centimeters.

registers.encoding: BE uint24, 1000 raw units per mm

claims: guest driver transaction path and encoding

runtime.blocker: Device-local results apply only to the recorded firmware, host, controller and Web paths. Other firmware or hosts do not inherit PASS. Captured-frame readability is separate from continuous sensor output, remaining visual bindings and physical validation.
